partners.mechanism_chain: HBB variants causing dyserythropoietic anemia (MONDO:0011382) —DISRUPTS→ HBB (HGNC:4827); HBB missense variants (e.g., Hb M variants) (MONDO:0018023) —DISRUPTS→ HBB (HGNC:4827); HBB (HGNC:4827) —DISRUPTS→ Hemoglobin synthesis and oxygen transport (REACT:R-HSA-164560); Hemoglobin synthesis and oxygen transport (REACT:R-HSA-164560) —LEADS_TO→ Anemia (HP:0001903); Hemoglobin synthesis and oxygen transport (REACT:R-HSA-164560) —LEADS_TO→ Methemoglobinemia (HP:0030172). Mutations in the HBB gene lead to two distinct functional outcomes. In dyserythropoietic anemia type 1, haploinsufficiency or loss-of-function variants in HBB disrupt normal hemoglobin synthesis and oxygen transport, leading to anemia.
